description: Who is this Base address? Wallet age (first transfer), first funder, contract or EOA, ETH balance and nonce, the latest transfers in and out (native, ERC-20, NFTs), top counterparties by count, and recent large transfers in USD (ETH, WETH, USDC, USDT), from Alchemy's transfer index; plus, from our launch history, tokens it deployed and how many lost their liquidity, and deployers it funded. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
